verdict.rationale: Skills ship as plain SKILL.md markdown files in a folder hierarchy (skills/engineering/tdd/SKILL.md), and the installer writes them into your repo as ordinary, editable files you own under an MIT license. The vendor says they work with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot, and a hands-on probe confirmed an install produced a readable ./.claude/skills/tdd/SKILL.md. missing for 10: hands-on verification of carrying the same copied files into a second, non-Claude harness.

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format

citations.quote: It writes the skills into your repo as ordinary files you own and can edit.
The installer writes editable files into your project.
Works with any agent Claude Code · Cursor · Codex · Copilot · 25 skills · MIT
selectively installed the single `tdd` skill to ./.claude/skills/tdd/, and the installed SKILL.md frontmatter (name: tdd) read back cleanly
